reading.title: Cleaner skies over the city
reading.text: Five years ago, the city emitted more carbon dioxide per person than almost anywhere in Europe. The new mayor came to office on a mission to change this. Drivers now need a permit to enter the centre, and petrol cars are not permitted at all on weekdays. Officials admit that the scheme had problems at first: the electric buses suffered intermittent breakdowns, and some poorer districts were omitted from the cycle network. Still, data transmitted by air-quality sensors show that emissions have fallen by a third, and the city has submitted its plan to the EU as a model.
